actions.pause_body: While paused, the job is hidden from workers, no alerts go out and no new candidates are shortlisted or invited. Candidates already in the pipeline stay where they are.
actions.resume_body: The job opens again: workers can see it and KaamSathi ops can shortlist new candidates.
actions.paused_banner: This job is paused. Workers can't see it and no new candidates are added until you resume it.

requirements.title: Extra requirements
requirements.hint: Optional. Matching gives extra points for each requirement met; workers missing a required one are left out.
requirements.limit: You can add up to {max} requirements.
requirements.required_hint: Required rows filter candidates; preferred rows only add points.
requirements.empty_error: Choose a credential, NSTB level or years — or remove this row.

invite.title: Invite a worker
invite.description: Invite someone you already know to “{job}”. They get an SMS and appear as shortlisted once invited.
invite.share_hint: Paste the link the worker shared with you, or just the code at its end.
invite.share_invalid: This doesn't look like a Skill Passport share link.
invite.past_title: People who worked for you before
invite.past_hint: Former workers whose employment with you has ended and who are not in this job yet.
invite.past_empty_body: Workers appear here after their employment with you has ended.

match.hint: Matching score when KaamSathi shortlisted this worker

tags.label: Tags
tags.placeholder: Add a tag, e.g. night shift
tags.too_long: Tags can be at most {max} characters.

interviews.title: Interviews
interviews.not_allowed: Interviews can be scheduled once the candidate is shortlisted.
interviews.schedule_hint: The candidate moves to Interview and gets an SMS reminder 2 hours before.
interviews.delete_body: The round is removed and the candidate won't get a reminder for it.
interviews.date_required: Choose the interview date and time
interviews.sms_hint: Times are Nepal time. The worker gets an SMS reminder 2 hours before.

ops.owner_hint: KaamSathi staff member responsible for this job.
ops.invited_count: {count, plural, one {# invited by employer} other {# invited by employer}}
ops.runs_hint: Each scoring run is saved with the algorithm version and weights used.

matching.title: Matching settings
matching.description: Points the matching algorithm gives for each factor. Changes apply to new scoring runs and are audited.
matching.audit_note: Every save or reset is recorded in the audit log.
matching.weights_hint: Whole numbers only. Each field shows its default and allowed range.
matching.invalid: Enter a whole number from {min} to {max}
matching.nothing_changed: Nothing to save — no weights changed.
matching.reset_body: Every weight goes back to its default value. New scoring runs will use the defaults.

weight_hints.district: Worker lives in the job's district.
weight_hints.nstb_per_level: Points for each NSTB level held.
weight_hints.experience_per_year: Points per year in the trade.
weight_hints.reliability_max: Most points from the reliability score.
weight_hints.preferred_district: Worker listed this district as preferred.
weight_hints.outcomes_max: Most points from past placements and ratings.
weight_hints.requirement_met: Points for each extra requirement met.
weight_hints.wage_penalty: Points taken off when expected wage is above the offer.
weight_hints.declined_penalty: Points taken off if the worker declined this employer before.
